mean_functions.informative_dropout: quadratic; if current observed VAS < 4 after minute 10, end observation after this minute

screen: bs8_cr2_t is the single prespecified candidate; coverage >= 0.90 and success >= 0.98 in every noninformative cell; alternative bs10 is diagnostic, not automatically selected
validation_gate: all noninformative cells: coverage >= 0.93, Wilson lower 95% bound >= 0.90, success >= 0.99; counts include failures as noncoverage; this is a limited simulation gate, not universal nominal-coverage proof
clinical_policy: No replacement unless independent validation gate passes; a failed validation stays failed
seed_policy: independent scenario/replicate data seeds and method draw seeds; no tuning using validation outcomes
development_basis: v2 bs6 fails wave scenario; v3 increases basis dimension, adds cluster leverage correction; no v2 validation was run
covariance: CR2: whiten by each subject marginal covariance; adjust residual by symmetric inverse square root of I-Xw (Xw_all transpose Xw_all)^-1 Xw transpose; use G-1 t reference as an approximation requiring simulation

flexible_basis.knots: equally spaced interior; dimension-4 knots; fixed boundaries [1,20]
